{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {total_patients}")
print(f"Number with severe baseline disease: {severe_count}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe:.4f}")"}
